race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
race.verdict: CASTILIAN QUEEN and Carafinn stand out on form, with Ger Lyons' filly preferred on the back of a well-advertised second here last time. Kathy M and Lochlane appeal most of the Joseph O'Brien contingent. CASTILIAN QUEEN CARAFINN (IRE) KATHY M (USA)
race.bettingForecast: Castilian Queen (9/4), Kathy M (5/1), Lochlane (7/1), Carafinn (7/1), Lady Chancalot (10/1), Solar Palace (10/1), Seanbonekapone (12/1), Fire In The Air (12/1), Guide Me Home (12/1), Kariata (12/1), Proper Naughty (14/1), Arddin (14/1), An Tuath Nua (16/1), Always Be Mine (25/1), Whiptail (25/1), Celestial Order (33/1), Silent Promise (100/1)
